# 4 bed semi-detached house for sale

> Property Partners OBrien Swaine are delighted to present this superb four-bedroom family home to the market in excellent condition throughout. No. 15 has recently been repainted throughout and fitted with new carpets, creating a bright, fresh and welcoming home ready for its new owners.
